# OceanAstra

> OceanAstra is a technology company headquartered in Dubai. We believe technology knows no borders — we bring the world's most advanced productivity to the Middle East, so that every company here has a wider set of choices.

OceanAstra Technologies L.L.C is a technology company registered in Dubai, United Arab Emirates, holding commercial licence 1646635 issued by the Department of Economy and Tourism, Government of Dubai. It serves enterprise clients across the UAE, the wider GCC and Greater China, and delivers in English, Arabic and Chinese.

## Lines of business

### AI Organisation Solutions

Management tools built on how work changes in the age of AI — enabling companies founded today, and giving established businesses a route into AI without tearing anything down.

- CorpOS (built in-house) — an AI-native management platform entered through instant messaging, where the organisation is made up of human colleagues and AI teammates
- Or keep the messaging platform you already use and add a CorpOS team of AI teammates to it — Lark + CorpOS, for example
- Management capability for newly founded companies, and a step-by-step transition path for established ones

### Industry Management Solutions

Either AI teammates who hold defined roles, or AI assistance layered onto existing work — a new way to manage the operations of a specific industry, and a way to bring AI to the systems that industry already runs.

- CarSaas — an ERP for automotive trading in the Middle East, currently in development and launching soon
- Flying — a cross-border trading system for construction and interior fit-out, delivered as a tailored solution that matches how each business actually trades
- AI capability added to the systems an industry already runs, without replacing them

### Integration Partnerships

Bringing proven technology from around the world into the Middle East: selection, integration, localised delivery and long-term support.

- Lark — deployment and integration of the all-in-one digital workplace across the region
- Amap — mapping and location services for logistics and field operations
- From requirement assessment through tenant setup, migration, training and support in three languages
